name: MonarchLifecycleBadge
title: LifecycleBadge
summary: The release stage of an API, SDK or feature (planned, preview, stable, deprecated) or a custom stage, as a quiet capsule with a coloured dot and a text label.
whenToUse: Beside the name of an API, endpoint, SDK or feature to say how far along it is, or for a custom stage such as a customer's lifecycle stage.
whenNotToUse: Not for the status of a record such as Paid or Draft (use MonarchBadge) and not for live presence (use MonarchStatusDot).
api: init(_ lifecycle: MonarchLifecycle, label: String? = nil, tone: MonarchTone? = nil, showsDot: Bool = true)
init(stage: String, label: String? = nil, tone: MonarchTone? = nil, showsDot: Bool = true)
enum MonarchLifecycle: String { case planned, preview, stable, deprecated }

options.name: lifecycle
options.description: The built-in stage: planned, preview, stable or deprecated.

options.name: stage
options.description: In the second initialiser, the key of a stage. One of the four built-in names is drawn as that stage; any other key is neutral and shown as readable text unless label and tone are given.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in label. Already localised.

options.name: tone
options.description: Replaces the tone of the stage: planned neutral, preview info, stable success, deprecated warning, anything else neutral.

options.name: showsDot
options.description: Whether the dot before the label is drawn.

appearance: A capsule in the surface colour with default text, a border in the tone's border colour and a dot in the tone's strong colour; the neutral dot is the subtle text colour. The same roles are used in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The parity map named MonarchBadge as the base. MonarchBadge colours its text with the tone and has no dot, so this component draws the web's quieter look from the same tone palette. The web's accent tone is not offered because MonarchTone has no accent case; the web's sm size is not offered, the label is the caption role and follows Dynamic Type. The web's messages map is the label parameter and the strings table. Android uses the same names.
accessibility: Read as its label; the dot is hidden from VoiceOver, so the label carries the meaning without the colour.
The label and the dot scale with Dynamic Type.
Not interactive: it has no button trait and no action.
edgeCases: A stage key the app does not know is shown as the key with underscores and hyphens turned into spaces and a capital first letter; that text is not localised.
Keys are matched exactly: "Stable" is not the built-in stage stable.
An empty key with no label draws a capsule with only the dot.
Long labels wrap inside the capsule.
